title: Monotonicity under positive bribery
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J\subseteq K$ be sets of coordinates. The mean after replacing the coordinates in $J$ by $1$ is at most the mean after replacing the coordinates in $K$ by $1$.
